name: onecarat-agent-office
description: Onecarat Agent Office - a small always-on-top window that shows what Claude Code is doing (Windows, local only)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p packages/adapter-claude-code && tsc -p packages/office-ui && tsc -p packages/launcher
scripts.build:inspect: npm run build && cargo build --release --locked --features custom-protocol,inspect --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target-dir src-tauri/target/inspect
